title: Eagle Tree Chicken Shit
description: A surreal scene features a large twisted tree with an eagle's head emerging from its trunk, vomiting a stream of pink and orange liquid. To the right, a blond superhero in a black and yellow costume with glowing gauntlets stands dynamically on a metal tub overflowing with colorful swirling ooze. The background shows a dark stormy sky with a glowing crescent moon and swirling purple clouds. The tree bears roses, peonies, grapes, and has a 'CHICKEN SHIT' sign at its base.
prompt: Surreal comic book scene of a twisted brown tree with a giant angry eagle head growing from the trunk, vomiting a stream of glowing pink and orange liquid. A blond male superhero in black tactical suit with yellow lightning bolt emblem and glowing orange gauntlets stands on a metal tub overflowing with colorful psychedelic ooze. The tree has blooming roses, peonies, and hanging grapes. Dark stormy sky with purple swirling clouds and a bright yellow crescent moon. Chicken Shit sign at the base, scattered feathers and glowing particles on the ground.
